nodes.label: Contiguous Angle-Sweep Geographic Clustering
nodes.rationale: Places are sorted by polar angle around the centroid and chunked into contiguous arc slices (Day 0 = first arc, Day 1 = next arc). Round-robin (i % daysCount) would interleave clusters and defeat the sweep, so each day stays a geographic cluster.

nodes.label: Random Rotation of Angle Sweep Start
nodes.rationale: The angle sort is deterministic, so without rotation a shuffled input produces the exact same arcs every run. Starting the sweep at a random offset (only when shuffle=true) changes where arc boundaries fall while keeping each day a contiguous slice of the circle.
nodes.norm_label: random rotation of angle sweep start

nodes.label: Order-Preserving Random Trim (sampleInOrder)
nodes.rationale: When shuffling, keep a random subset of at most k items but re-sort the picked indices ascending to preserve the original angle-sweep order, so the trimmed day still reads as one contiguous arc. Trim is applied per-day after assignment because a global pre-trim would just drop the tail in createdAt order and destroy spatial clusters.

nodes.label: Random Nearest-Neighbour Start Point
nodes.rationale: The greedy nearest-neighbour walk starts at a random point when shuffle=true (index 0 otherwise) so the within-day walking path varies between shuffled runs; the greedy traversal itself remains deterministic given the start.

nodes.label: Pre-Shuffle Limitation of Eligible Places
nodes.rationale: Fisher-Yates-style pre-shuffle of eligible places alone cannot vary output because assignDays re-sorts by angle; it only randomizes angle-sort ties (co-located places) and the no-coords round-robin. The real shuffle variation comes from the random sweep rotation, the random in-order trim, and the random nearest-neighbour start.

nodes.label: Itinerary Generation Algorithm (documented)
nodes.rationale: Documents the pipeline: eligibility filter (lat/lon required), optional shuffle, angle-sweep contiguous-arc day assignment, per-day trim applied after assignment to preserve spatial clusters (a global pre-trim would drop the createdAt tail), and nearest-neighbour greedy ordering within each day with short days (<=2) skipping the greedy pass.

nodes.label: Chat Side-Effect Contract (documented)
nodes.rationale: The chat route does no side-effect work itself; it returns sideEffects[] which the client applies (search, refresh_itineraries, generate). If the generate POST throws, the client surfaces the real error as 'Generation failed: <msg>' instead of the LLM's optimistic message.

nodes.label: Drag Re-Anchor Pattern
nodes.rationale: Drag uses a re-anchor pattern (lastY / currentHeight advanced only by actualDelta) so the cursor stays glued to the divider line in both directions, even after pushing past a bound. Bounds: min = default 256px, max = the inner list's natural offsetHeight.
